ammonia.reason: 24 mo deamination raises ammonia-N but low moisture and pH 5.55 retain NH4+, little free NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: No washed-rind coryneforms; p-cresol/indole only trace FD from raw-milk pasture feed.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic alpha-s1 casein peptides accumulate but trimmed by NSLAB carboxypeptidases over 24 mo.

blue_moldy.reason: 2-heptanone 1840 ug/kg and 2-nonanone 3670 ug/kg from fatty-acid beta-oxidation, no Penicillium added.

browning.reason: High protein 32.5% plus free amino acids and residual galactose drive Maillard when grated and heated.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl only 26 ug/kg; citrate depleted early by thermophilic starters and diacetyl reduced to acetoin.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic acid 482 mg/kg and hexanoic acid 260 mg/kg from lipolysis and amino-acid catabolism.

creaminess.reason: 29.2% moisture with 32.5% protein and tyrosine crystals prevents creamy mouth-coating despite 30.6% fat.

crumbliness.reason: Low moisture plus 24 mo proteolysis and tyrosine/calcium-lactate crystals give short fracture.

firmness.reason: Cooked to ~55C, pressed, brined 20-24d and dried 24 mo to 29.2% moisture with crosslinked paracasein.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde 380 ug/kg from phenylalanine Strecker degradation by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Ethyl hexanoate 2580 ug/kg, ethyl butanoate 1140 ug/kg and ethyl octanoate 1620 ug/kg via esterase esterification.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caprine branched acids; octanoic 147 mg/kg gives only mild waxy sharpness.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal 680 ug/kg, 2-methylpropanal 520 ug/kg and 2-methylbutanal 490 ug/kg from Leu/Val/Ile Strecker.

melt.reason: pH 5.55 and 24 mo proteolysis with 29.2% moisture and 1.6% salt; softens and oils but does not flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not detected; no surface mold lipoxygenase activity.

oil_off.reason: 30.6% fat coalesced into free-fat pools during cooking and long aging releases oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking process; guaiacol only trace feed-derived phenol, mold none.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 1424 mg/kg from thermophilic lactobacilli fermentation and 24 mo ripening.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated cooked curd, not pasta-filata; no hot-water kneaded demineralized casein alignment.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methional 100 ug/kg and dimethyl trisulfide 30 ug/kg from methionine catabolism; cooked volatiles largely lost.

sweet.reason: Lactose fully fermented; slight sweet impression from Pro/Gly/Ala and fruity esters only.

umami.reason: Extensive 24 mo proteolysis liberates glutamate with 1.6% NaCl synergizing savory brothy granary note.
